stories.title: [AINews] not much happened today
stories.summary:
↳ WHAT'S NEW
No major model drops, API changes, or benchmark claims today. The pipeline is quiet.

↳ THE REAL STORY
After a week of back-to-back releases — models, APIs, and the usual benchmark theater — the industry took a breath. For developers, that's actually useful: a day where nothing ships is a day to catch up on what already did. If you've been queuing up evaluations, reading changelogs, or just trying to decide which of last week's models is worth integrating, today is that window.
stories.considerations: The real question after a sprint like last week isn't 'what's next' — it's which of those releases will still matter in 30 days. Most won't. The ones worth your time are the ones that changed a constraint you actually hit: context limits, latency, cost per token, or API stability. Everything else is noise with a press release attached.
